headline: Tecil Chemicals reports cessation of secretarial auditors JMACS Associates
hook: Secretarial auditor steps down at Tecil Chemicals
summary: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited has informed the stock exchange that JMACS Associates Practising Company Secretaries has ceased to be its secretarial auditors effective November 4, 2026. Secretarial auditors are responsible for ensuring the company complies with applicable corporate laws and regulations. The company has not yet named a replacement auditor in this regulatory filing. Indian retail investors holding shares should note this routine administrative change in governance personnel.
whats_next: Appointment of a new secretarial auditor by the company.
why_it_matters: Routine auditor change with no direct impact on share price.
